findings.evidence: `rg` finds `steinberg_suzuki`, `steinberg_reeG2`, `steinberg_reeF4`, `steinberg_tits`, `Group_suzuki`, `Group_reeG2`, `Group_reeF4`, and `Group_tits` only at their declarations; inspection shows all 21 branch equations close with `by rfl`.
findings.fix: Delete these branch wrappers; consumers can unfold `ValidLieTypeIndex.steinberg` or `ValidLieTypeIndex.Group`, while substantive uniform behavior is already exposed by `steinberg_simpleRootSubgroup_of_*` and `Group_eq_of_not_usesHalfFrobenius`.
findings.issue: The 17 `steinberg_*` branch theorems (lines 53–133) and four `Group_*` branch theorems (lines 211–232) are thin duplicate APIs: every proof is `rfl` and no in-repository code consumes them.

summary: The Lie-type dispatcher adds unused public branch equations that only restate definitional reductions, duplicating the canonical dispatcher API.
